description: A Dart class 'AuthApi' that provides authentication-related API calls such as login and signup, utilizing an external 'ApiClient' for HTTP requests.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: A class encapsulating authentication API calls, including login and signup functionalities using an API client.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login credentials to the server and retrieves a bearer token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Sends signup credentials to the server and retrieves a bearer token upon successful registration.
